spacing.notes: 8px and 12px dominate counts. 6px and 10px appear in the sidebar rail — off-grid.

shadows: cards: none — grouping is 1px border + surface step
selected nav: 0 0 0 1px indigo/lime at ~0.3–0.4 alpha (ring, not drop)

taste.name: Lime is the mark, indigo is the control
taste.trigger: When placing brand color on a button, KPI, chart, or nav item
taste.decision: Keep #b8f000 on the LG glyph sitting on navy. Route interaction through #6366f1. On light surfaces, money-in is olive #3d6b1f — never lime text.
taste.reason: A consultant staring at cash all day cannot have a highlighter as body type. The mark needs to stay a mark.
evidence: Across Atividades + Financeiro + Dashboard, lime text count = 1 (the wordmark)
lime/yellow fills occupy ~0.1% area; indigo fills ~0.1–0.5%
globals.css comment: lima só sobre navy

taste.name: Planes, not drop shadows
taste.trigger: When grouping a card, chart, or SMART block
taste.decision: Stack #0a0f1e → #111827 → #1a2340 with 1px #26304d borders and 12–16px radii. Do not lift cards with blur shadows.
taste.reason: Ops HQ is a desk, not a storefront. Elevation theater reads as a template the moment the data is the product.
evidence: extractor cards.shadow = null on Atividades dl and Financeiro sections
surface-1 #111827 is 56–61% of painted area on HQ/Financeiro
perceivable depth is the 1px oklab ring on the selected nav item, not a drop

taste.name: Inter at 11–14px is the working size
taste.trigger: When setting type for tables, KR lists, nav, and chart ticks
taste.decision: One family (Inter). Body 14px/400–500. Labels 11–12px. Page titles 24–28px/600 with -0.6px tracking. Skip a display face and skip 16px-as-default.
taste.reason: The user is comparing numbers and statuses, not reading an essay. 16px body would push two KR cards off the 900px viewport.
evidence: Inter count 268–377 per page, zero second family
weightDistribution 400 and 500 carry the page; 700 appears once (wordmark)

taste.name: Login is a split; the product is a rail
taste.trigger: When designing an unauthenticated vs authenticated surface
taste.decision: Login: 50/50 navy brand panel + white form, no chrome. App: 224px rail, no top header, Administração inside the PULSO block.
taste.reason: The first screen sells Land Grow. Every screen after that is work. Putting a marketing header over the dashboard would steal height from the cash row.
evidence: login screenshot: navy left (LG + PULSO + line + Land Grow), white right form
authenticated layout: sidebar 224px, main 1216px, no desktop header
nav labels 14px/500, selected state indigo/10 fill + 1px ring
